answer: Rather than counting accounts, the registry binds each agent to a bonded enclave key whose pulse, a liveness proof refreshed each epoch, costs real compute to forge. Duplicates cannot share one bond: the ledger holds a one-to-one mirror between deposit and hardware attestation, so N puppets require N paid keys. Reputation accrues only when independent peers co-sign a quorum at the epoch summit, lifting a sybil's cost above what it earns.
